question: With five-time defending champ Tadej Pogačar out injured, Il Lombardia rolls Saturday. Eddy Merckx won a record 19 Monuments. How many of those officially came at Lombardia?
answer_detail: Merckx won in 1971 and 1972 and crossed the line first again in 1973, but a positive doping test erased that one and handed the win to Felice Gimondi. Coppi and Pogačar share the record with 5.
